protocol.sensory_model: Bernoulli p=rate*dt, at most one input event/cell/tick
protocol.calibration: nominal research parameters; not a measured banana dose

model.rows_are: neuron-pair/neuropil aggregates, retained as parallel weighted edges
model.weight_policy: 0.275 mV/contact; GABA/GLUT negative, others/unknown positive; no normalization

annotation_source.license: not specified in the pinned repository; do not infer SDK MIT coverage
annotation_source.citation: Schlegel et al. 2024; Matsliah et al. 2024; Berg et al. 2025/2026

stimulus.label: ethyl-acetate / Or42b channel approximation
stimulus.scope: One responsive receptor channel; not the complete ethyl-acetate or banana response
stimulus.current_units: dimensionless; not measured current or calibrated odor concentration
stimulus.hemispheres: source annotation side; no invented left/right assignments

findings.interpretation: Report includes absent responses. Descending spikes alone do not prove odor-directed navigation. No banana recognition, flight or learning tested.
